meta.title: Leo and the Big Yellow Scarf

paragraphs: It was a cold, windy Monday. "Yesterday was hot, and today is cold," said Lily. "What a big difference!" Lily and Mia walked to school with Leo. Many children on the road wore coats and hats too. Lily held her hat with both hands. Lily wore a gray sweater and a red hat. Mia wore a long blue coat and boots. Leo wore a big yellow scarf, but he did not smile. "What's the matter, Leo?" asked Mia. "I have a toothache," said Leo. "It hurts badly." "You must tell Teacher Kim," said Lily.

At school, Teacher Kim looked at Leo's face. "Oh dear," she said. She called Leo's mom. Then she opened an app on her phone. "The wind is strong today," said Teacher Kim. "Leo, you must wear your scarf and your hat." Leo's mom came to the door. She talked loudly because of the wind. "Come, Leo," she said. "We can see the doctor now." Leo said, "Goodbye, everyone!" Lily and Mia sat at their desks and looked at his chair.

After lunch, Leo came back to class. He had a big smile. "The doctor looked at my tooth," he said. He told the class about the doctor's big chair and the funny lamp. "Now it is fine." "Good!" said Mia. "Take off your scarf, Leo." "No, thank you!" said Leo. "It's cold, and I like my scarf." He wore it all day, in class too. Everyone laughed, and Leo laughed too.
text.summary: It is a cold, windy day, and Leo comes to school in a big yellow scarf. He has a toothache, so Teacher Kim calls his mom. Later he comes back with a smile.
